fields.FIR_Description: According to the complaint registered on 2025-09-06, the complainant lost a gold chain of about 4 sovereigns near Anbu Colony Highway Junction when a rider on a maroon motorcycle bearing registration number TN-47-ZZ-1038 grabbed it and sped away. The incident is stated to have occurred on 2025-09-06 at about 19:35. Geetha Kumari approached Karur East PS to report the matter and can be reached on 9000000202. No independent witness was identified at the time of registration. Anand Palanisamy (9000000093), described as a co-worker, was also mentioned in the complaint. Nandha Karuppasamy (mobile 9000000113) was named as a possible person of interest. Potentially relevant material referenced includes CCTV footage. Records suggest a possible link with FIR-2026-00173, as the mobile number 9000000113 is associated with a suspect in both entries.
fields.Modus_Operandi: Suspect allegedly snatched the chain from a passing two-wheeler.
fields.Keywords: chain snatching, two-wheeler, suspect, mobile number, motorcycle, CCTV, evening, associate
